plates.title: Contour Field
plates.description: Nested contour lines march across a single ridge, each offset by a fixed interval. Read as a topographic survey of something that does not exist.

plates.title: Strata
plates.description: Horizontal sediment bands stacked at uneven intervals, cut by a slow diagonal fault that displaces every layer it crosses.

plates.title: Topography
plates.description: Radial contour rings rising from an off-centre peak. Ring spacing tightens toward the summit, the way real contours do.

plates.title: Moire
plates.description: Two fine gratings at a 9.5 unit pitch, one vertical and one horizontal, counter-rotated by thirteen degrees. The beat bands between them are not drawn — they are produced by your eye.

plates.title: Circuit
plates.description: Orthogonal copper traces on a two-layer grid, terminating in round pads. Junctions avoid ninety-degree corners except where a pad forces one.

plates.title: Radial Burst
plates.description: Rays thrown from an origin that deliberately sits off the centre of the plate, so the composition leans rather than balances.

plates.title: Brutalist Blocks
plates.description: Offset concrete slabs with hairline borders and one solid acid plane. Mass without shadow — depth is carried entirely by surface value.

plates.title: Orbit
plates.description: Five concentric orbital rings drawn as open arcs of differing sweep, each carrying satellite markers. One acid ellipse crosses them all on a tilted axis.

plates.title: Blueprint
plates.description: A working drawing sheet: fine and major grids, two dimensioned circles with arrowed extension lines, a dashed centreline, and a title block in the lower right.

plates.title: Lattice
plates.description: A forty-five degree lattice of outlined cells, each inset to leave a regular gap, with a diagonal band of cells filled solid acid.

plates.title: Spiral Dash
plates.description: A dashed Archimedean spiral of twelve turns over radiating tick marks, with a second and third copy at different dash phases to build interference.

plates.title: Waveform
plates.description: Stacked sine ribbons of increasing amplitude and decreasing phase. One band is filled to show where a real signal would carry its energy.

plates.title: Halftone
plates.description: A halftone dot field whose radius is driven by a diagonal tonal ramp crossed by two sine wave fields and a hot-spot, stepping cyan through off-white to acid lime.

plates.title: Prism
plates.description: One incident ray striking the left face of an outlined prism, splitting into a nine-line fan that disperses through the glass and exits the right face with visible deviation.

plates.title: Vortex
plates.description: Twenty-four narrow wedges spiralling clockwise around an off-centre core, alternating in opacity so the rotation reads as a pinwheel rather than a starburst.

plates.title: Dot Matrix Face
plates.description: A portrait resolved as a matrix of dots on a fifteen by eleven grid, with dot radius driven by a key light from the upper left, an acid core on the lit cheek and a cyan rim light down the right contour.
